event_chain.summary: Verifier RPC nodes poisoned to deliver forged cross-chain message

summary: On April 18, 2026 attackers drained 116,500 rsETH, about $292 million, from Kelp DAO's LayerZero-powered bridge that backed wrapped rsETH on more than 20 chains. According to LayerZero, the attackers gained access to the RPC node list used by its verifier, poisoned two RPC nodes to deliver a forged cross-chain message and knocked the clean nodes offline with a denial of service attack; Kelp's single-verifier setup accepted the message. Kelp's emergency multisig paused contracts 46 minutes later, lending markets froze rsETH, and LayerZero preliminarily attributed the attack to North Korea's Lazarus Group (TraderTraitor).
